macos-sdk-bindings.reason: Upstream SDK-derived-binding uncertainty remains documented. Proceed with native macOS builds under the dependencies’ declared licences and normal Apple build tools; retain upstream notices and exclude Apple SDKs/system frameworks from packages. No specific prohibition for this distribution was established by this review. This is a recorded release decision, not an Apple permission grant or legal resolution.
macos-sdk-bindings.release_basis: Maintainer approved established-practice review. Historical uncertainty alone is non-blocking; newly identified conflicting terms or unauthorized bundled material must block release.
